landing.waMessage: Hello Arah, I am interested in Entaris for my business.
landing.sectors: Used by rice mills, biomass pellet plants, trading and distribution, and small to mid-size manufacturers.

hero.title: Your business operations and finances, in one system.
hero.body: Entaris brings accounting, inventory, production, purchasing, and sales together on double-entry bookkeeping. AIRA, its built-in AI agent, helps read the data and prepare routine work.

diagram.label: Entaris data flow: transaction modules to the ledger, then to reports and AIRA
diagram.caption: Every module writes to one ledger
diagram.ledgerNote: Double-entry journals are created automatically from every transaction

modules.title: Documents follow your workflow
modules.desc: Each document carries data from the previous step, and every step that touches money or stock creates a journal right away.
modules.approvals: Staff requests wait for supervisor approval before posting, in the app or through Telegram.

sales.title: Sales
sales.note: Returns, customer deposits, and receivables aging are recorded too.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.note: Price differences between goods receipts and invoices are posted automatically. Supplier deposits and payables aging are available.

inventory.title: Inventory and production
inventory.note: Weighted average COGS, yield, conversion cost, and machine OEE.

finance.title: Finance
finance.note: Employee payment requests and fixed assets go into the same ledger.

steps.statements: Balance sheet and profit and loss

aira.title: An AI agent that works on your transaction data
aira.desc: AIRA reads the same ledger as your finance team. It helps answer questions and prepare work, while decisions stay with you.

ask.title: Ask in everyday language
ask.desc: Ask for a sales summary, cash position, or stock without building the report yourself.

drafts.title: It prepares drafts, you approve
drafts.desc: AIRA drafts transactions. Nothing is posted until you approve it.

ledger.title: Reasons from the same ledger
ledger.desc: Answers come from posted transaction data, not from a separate copy.

principles.title: Built for numbers you can trust

integrity.title: Data integrity
integrity.desc: Every module posts to one ledger, so operational and financial reports read the same data.

security.title: Security and audit trail
security.desc: Configurable role-based access, and every action is recorded.

growth.title: Ready to grow
growth.desc: One installation per company. Modules can be turned on as the business needs them.

cta.title: Talk to our team about your business needs
cta.body: We support the implementation, move data from spreadsheets or old systems, and train your team. Your data stays your company's.
